The UI has a segmented filter (All, Active, Pending, Blocked, Done) above a list of eight items. Each item shows a title, a status and a one-line detail.

The catalog has no way to wire the filter to the list. The filter control is in place, but the client has to do the filtering. Also, the catalog has no single-column container, so I used a one-column `columns` layout as the root.
